source.title: Viscosity and Thermal Conductivity Equations for Nitrogen, Oxygen, Argon, and Air
source.visual_verification: Formula, Table I/II, first three Table IV terms and zero-density Table V rows visually checked from PDF pages 3/4/6/8. PDF unit is micro-Pa s, not milli-Pa s from text extraction.

settings.scope: Only zero-density eta0(T), lambda0(T) and temperature derivatives for pure N2/O2. The paper explicitly labels Table V values as calculated numerical reference values, not measurement accuracy. No density residual, critical enhancement, pressure conversion, mixture law or binary diffusivity; no automatic replacement of GRI transport. The fitted prefactor and molar masses remain those of the publication.
